1995.simple: A thick grey laptop with a card in its side, and a curly cable from the card to a mobile phone the size of a brick. The phone does the calling; the laptop does the rest.
1995.technical: A 1995 laptop with a GSM data card (a PC card, like Nokia’s Cellular Data Card) on a cable to a GSM phone. The endpoint: it runs PPP, IP, TCP and the browser itself; the phone just carries the call.
